selectionNote: Selected 13 guided Cancun d631 products with live public USD From prices, combined ratings, and unique 674x446 heroes. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (EUR/CAD/AUD) blocked many otherwise-strong SKUs from being verified in USD on a complete product page. Dedicated helicopter, stargazing, wine-only, and guided bike d631 pages with combined USD+rating+hero dumps were not captured. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, Playa/Tulum/Cozumel destination IDs, thin-review SKUs, or products with unusable heroes.
